verdict.rationale: Porkbun's REST/JSON API lets you register domains, manage DNS and provision hosting end to end with no dashboard. Several features suit unattended automation: API keys that work with account 2FA on, keys scoped to IPs and domains, a sandbox key with fake credit, dryRun pre-flight checks, Idempotency-Key retries and signed webhooks. An npx-launchable MCP server is also offered, and a probe confirms llms.txt is live. Missing for 10: explicit CI-pipeline guidance or examples, independent or hands-on corroboration of headless use, and a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (probe returned 404).
